My starting routine
The same 4 steps for every question
READ
What is given? Read the Note too.
MARK
Underline what is asked. Number the clues.
WRITE
Write the gaps between the terms.
CHECK
Test every option against the rule.

Watch out!
The pattern rule changes from question to question.
QuestionWatch forExample
Q 1Count only the NEXT 20 terms.The terms already shown do not count.
Q 2Exactly one term is wrong.Fix it and every later term should fit.
Q 3Each term is a group, not one number.The symbols stand in for some numbers.
Q 7Hexagons and diamonds grow by different rules.Count both in every term.
Q 10At most 30 cubes.Using fewer than 30 cubes is allowed.

What comes next? 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ?
a) 20
b) 21

Before you open a hint, write your plan in one line:
Hint 1 · Echo
Say it in your own words: "Each number grows from the one before. By how much each time?"
Hint 2 · Translator
Write the gaps under the series. Now the gaps make a series of their own.
Hint 3 · Roots
Ask why the gaps change. Is there a rule hiding in the gaps?
YOUR TURN
Find the next gap, then add it to 16.
Use the hints one at a time. Try on your own before you read the next one.
Before you start
There is no activity in this chapter. Keep a pencil ready to write the gaps under each series.
Challenge ahead
The Thinking Spot is a three-shot puzzle: plan your shots to remove as many items as you can.
